TaskDescription: Mental simulation of running along city and forest trails shown as images (6 images of 5 s per block), with lower-than-expected (positive PEexert) or higher-than-expected (negative PEexert) physical exertion.
Instructions: 'Imagine running on the trail in the pictures in the near future and you experience a lesser [higher] level of physical effort than anticipated.' (positive [negative] PEexert). Given in English or French according to the participant's preference.
